title: Newsletter plugin: subscriber store, double opt-in signup and confirmation email
description: amplify/plugins/newsletter: KMS-encrypted plugin table (not an Amplify model), HMAC address ids, signed expiring single-use confirm tokens, consent evidence (wording, confirmedAt, IP, UA), rate limits and honeypot, POST /api/newsletter/subscribe and confirm page as CMS Next routes, optional Prospectus siteSubject, papyrus-newsletter web component. Done when a reader subscribes on a site, receives a confirmation email and confirms.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/532 merged to develop (CI green: python, ts, smoke). Newsletter plugin foundation: table + KMS + generated key + Python Lambda (CMS compute role only), routes /api/newsletter/subscribe and /confirm, the version 1 papyrus-newsletter web component, docs/newsletter.md. Verified: typecheck, lint, test-newsletter-plugin (config, manifest/schema, synth), test-newsletter-api, pytest (moto), behave newsletter-double-opt-in (18 scenarios), bundle import check. Not yet enabled on a site; story stays open until it works on Shipped.
